content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: These related specifications extend how XML documents refer to external resources, address fragments, represent links, or define a logical information model. They are optional specialist tools rather than requirements for every XML application.

content_blocks.title: Connect the subtopics
content_blocks.text: This lesson explicitly covers: Base URI semantics; Resolving relative references; Nested base URI settings; URI resolution in XML applications. Treat these as connected parts of one workflow: define the structure, make the relevant assumptions explicit, and verify a result with a small known input.

content_blocks.title: Inspectable example: XML Base
content_blocks.expected_output: A relative reference can be resolved using the inherited base URI; exact resolution follows the XML Base and URI rules.

Run it only in a processor that supports the shown language/version; the standard CodeLeaf playground previews HTML/CSS/JavaScript only and does not execute XML, XSD, XPath, XSLT, XQuery, Python, or SQL. For signature or encryption workflows, use standards-based cryptographic libraries and validate the complete protocol, not a hand-written fragment.
